name: element.readImage
title: Read image
summary: Return an image file from the repository of an element, named by the destination of a Markdown image relative to the element file, with its bytes, media type and size, so an agent or the web UI can show an image the text embeds.
details: The destination is read as in the element's text: a backslash before ASCII punctuation is removed, a query and a fragment are dropped, and the rest is percent-decoded (an invalid encoding stays as written). It is not a local path (SR-142): it never leaves the repository of the element. Refused, in this order, with details.reason: a scheme (https:, data:, file:, C:), a leading /, a .. that leads out of the repository, or a nested Git repository or another repository of the workspace inside this one (image-outside-repository, details.cause scheme, absolute, parent or nested); a file that is not there, a folder, a symbolic link on the way or at the file, a path through .git, node_modules or a folder the workspace file ignores, a name spelled other than on disk (also only in case), a name Windows changes or a \ after decoding (image-missing); a file or folder that cannot be read (file.faulty, image-unreadable); a file over 20 MiB (image-too-large, with details.size and details.limit); and a file whose content is no AVIF, BMP, GIF, JPEG, PNG, WebP or SVG image, whatever its extension (not-an-image). An SVG is returned unchanged.

ref.description: The element whose text would embed the image; the destination is relative to the folder of its file.

destination.description: The destination as a Markdown image of the element's text has it, without <...> and without a title, e.g. SR-825b7146fb54/layout.png or ../images/Wind%20map.svg. The element's text need not embed it.

repository.description: Which of the elements ref names is meant: the workspace name of its repository, as details.candidates of ref.ambiguous give it (SR-088). Only the elements ref names count; when none of them lies there, the error is ref.unknown with them as details.candidates.

file.description: Which of the elements ref names is meant: its file, relative to its repository, as details.candidates of ref.ambiguous give it. Give repository too when the same path is in several repositories; when several elements are still left, the error is ref.ambiguous with them.

content.title: Content
content.description: The bytes of the file, byte for byte, as base64 (RFC 4648, with padding).

mediaType.title: Media type
mediaType.description: The media type by the content of the file, not by its extension.

size.title: Size
size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
